rules.statement: A competent authority must form an opinion that the land is lawfully entitled to the State before issuing a quit notice under the State Lands (Recovery of Possession) Act.
rules.supporting_quote: When one considers the detailed provisions of the Act, which has been outlined above, and the objective that is sought to be achieved, which is the expeditious recovery of State land from persons who are in unauthorised occupation of such State lands, it is the view of this Court that the Competent Authority is only required to form an opinion that the impugned land is land to which the State is lawfully entitled to, and that the possession or occupation is unauthorized.
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: State Lands (Recovery of Possession) Act No. 7 of 1979
